integrity: Analytical proof for every admissible finite class size; independent exact Python enumeration checks 715 feasible-profile cases and 161 unrestricted literal-utility cases. These finite checks corroborate rather than replace the universal proof. Priority beyond the inspected literature is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Exact statement restricted to symmetric aversion-to-enemies utilities with three complete tripartite role classes, friendship weight 1, same-role weight minus the population size, and individually rational partitions. The zero-maximum case does not enumerate optimizers; four-or-more classes and incomplete friendship networks are not addressed.
title: Exact Nash welfare and optimal-partition counts on complete tripartite friendship graphs
